key_insight: A large language model, combined with Lean 4 verification, produced a machine-checked proof resolving the long-open FGG conjecture for depth-p QAOA on the ring of disagrees.
engineering_relevance: This shows a practical workflow for using AI plus formal methods to accelerate trustworthy progress on hard quantum algorithms and other open problems.
method: Formalized the QAOA problem and known results in Lean 4 using an existing quantum information library.
Reduced the conjecture to one remaining mathematical gap and asked the model to construct the missing proof.
Closed the loop with agentic tooling and Lean verification until the proof checked mechanically.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an end-to-end machine-verified proof in Lean 4 of the conjectured exact approximation ratio \((2p+1)/(2p+2)\).
watch_item: The result still depends on human validation that the formal Lean statement faithfully captures the intended quantum optimization claim.
paper_title: A Machine-Verified Proof of a Quantum-Optimization Conjecture
